sources.title: Seven Lessons for Every Robotics Founder From the 'Godfather of Self-Driving Cars'
sources.quote_checked: If an LLM hallucinates, you say 'that's wrong.' Then you shrug and move on. | a device that weighs a tonne travelling at 60 miles per hour in downtown San Francisco | If I had a magic wand, I would force every software person to spend one year just building hardware. | I think the incremental path is hard. | If you want to change the world, you might as well change it in a big way. | You have to be incredibly arrogant about the mountain you want to climb. | Companies tend to die most often from the inside, not the outside. | They mean well, the same way you mean well. | Whatever you think is impossible, it becomes possible just a year later.

sources.title: Sebastian Thrun on the next wave of AI
sources.quote_checked: Artificial intelligence will shift from a global engine to a local engine. | rarely does AI directly replace people – what's more common is AI working together with people. | whatever you believe your job is, you can be sure that it is going to be different five years from now. | Use AI to try things out, because true innovation is non-linear. | I'm not against regulations, but I think regulation should occur when it's clear what the abuse is.
